I'M IAN MCGONIGAL

By day I'm an airfield management operations manager with the U.S. Air Force. The rest of the time I'm a game developer, indie author and tabletop maker, and I've run an online collectibles store since 2004.

This site is my portfolio. Dock at GAMES to see the games I've made. CREATIVE holds my books, tabletop game rules and the other creative things I've written. STORE is where you can find the collectibles and trading cards I sell. SOCIALS has my socials and resume.

Enter space to fly between the warp gates, and spawn an enemy if you fancy a fight.
